description: UK Global Tariff commodity lookup by 10-digit commodity code from the official UK Trade Tariff API: description, chapter, validity dates, declarable flag and basic duty rate (null when the API leaves it empty). Full duty measures per trading partner are not expanded. Related tools on this server, for a different need: logistics_ftz_foreign_trade_zone when you need Pending US Foreign-Trade Zone Board applications with open; logistics_japan_customs_tariff when you need Japan Customs import tariff lines for an HS heading. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

code.description: 10-digit UK commodity code, e.g. 0901110000 (must be an existing leaf code)

name: logistics_uk_trade_tariff
title: UK Global Tariff commodity lookup by 10-digit commodity
